build: CMake Release: -O3 -DNDEBUG C++17 for both large probes
measurement: Native steady_clock; execution process RSS/HWM before validation, including the independent Clifford oracle and circuit inputs; total RSS/HWM also includes inverses, snapshots and copied verification branches. noncliff_ms includes atomicity checkpoints; T_gate_ms separately times successful T executions. The full matrix and warmups verify restore/inverse/RNG; timing-only repeated samples retain forward invariants and skip repeated restore/inverse.
parallel_measurement: Fresh subprocesses; one warmup per worker count; 7 interleaved samples, alternating 1/2/4/8 and 8/4/2/1; process RSS/HWM immediately after timed queries and before negative input tests.
